shell_commands:
git add src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: inline validation checks to properly narrow TypeScript discriminated union type

The handleValidationError function returned a boolean, which TypeScript
could not use to narrow the ValidationResult discriminated union type.
Inlining the checks allows TypeScript to understand that validation.data
only exists when validation.valid is true, fixing the type errors.

Also removes the handleValidationError function to resolve the eslint
callee-below-caller error.
EOF
)" && git status
git push origin HEAD && git status
